messages.content: Hi! How can I help you today?
Hello! I need to change the passenger name on my flight reservation.

To assist you with changing the passenger name on your flight reservation, I need to know your user ID and the reservation ID. Could you please provide those? If you don't know your reservation ID, I can help you locate it.
Sure, my user ID is anya_garcia_5901 and my reservation ID is 3RK2T9.

Please provide the new passenger details including first name, last name, and date of birth for each passenger in the reservation. Also, please confirm that the number of passengers will remain the same.
I just want to change the name from Mei Lee to Mei Garcia. The number of passengers stays the same.

You want to change the passenger name from Mei Lee to Mei Garcia on your reservation 3RK2T9. The number of passengers remains the same.

Please confirm if you want me to proceed with updating the passenger name to Mei Garcia with the same date of birth (1989-12-13).
Yes, please go ahead and update the name to Mei Garcia with the same date of birth.
